summary: The Phoenix project description requires revisions to ensure compliance and avoid potential misinterpretations as investment advice or compliance approval.
top_technical_reasons: Lack of explicit statements regarding the system's limitations and potential biases
Insufficient detail on data sources, validation, and evidence classes
Unclear boundaries between AI-generated proposals and human approvals

next_experiments.hypothesis: Improved transparency and explicit statements on limitations and biases will reduce the risk of misinterpretation
next_experiments.change: Revise the project description to include clear statements on limitations and biases
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This experiment will help determine whether revised language can effectively mitigate compliance risks

next_experiments.hypothesis: Enhanced data validation and evidence classes will improve the system's reliability and trustworthiness
next_experiments.change: Implement additional data validation and evidence classification mechanisms
next_experiments.metric_gate: Data quality and evidence class metrics
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This experiment will help evaluate the effectiveness of enhanced data validation and evidence classes in improving system reliability

data_or_label_risks: Potential for misinterpretation of AI-generated proposals as investment advice
Risk of incomplete or inaccurate data sources and validation
Insufficient transparency and explainability of model outputs and decisions
